title: Weaviate Chunk Schema
description: Schema for storing document chunks in Weaviate for hybrid search

weaviate_class.description: Text chunk from academic document for semantic search

properties.name: text
properties.description: Chunk text content (vectorized for semantic search)

properties.name: chunk_id
properties.description: Docling self_ref - primary key linking to SQLite chunks.id

hybrid_search_config.description: Configuration for hybrid BM25 + vector search
hybrid_search_config.limit_description: Number of chunks to retrieve before LLM scoring

hybrid_search.description: Search for chunks relevant to a topic
hybrid_search.graphql: { Get { Chunk( hybrid: { query: "impact of social media on political polarization" alpha: 0.5 } limit: 50 ) { text chunk_id document_id page_num section_path _additional { score } } } }

filter_by_document.description: Get all chunks from a specific document
filter_by_document.graphql: { Get { Chunk( where: { path: ["document_id"] operator: Equal valueInt: 1 } ) { text chunk_id page_num } } }

go_interface.description: Go client interface for Weaviate operations

contract_tests.name: TestWeaviateSchemaCreation
contract_tests.description: Verify schema can be created and retrieved

contract_tests.name: TestWeaviateHybridSearch
contract_tests.description: Verify hybrid search returns ranked results with scores
